The BTR is a taxi service on Woods. It will take you to another BTR location for a price that changes based on if you are a Scav or a PMC. Expect to pay as much as 10,000 rubles for each trip. You have about 2 minutes to book your trip with the BTR driver, else you'll be automatically removed from the vehicle.

Also via the BTR, PMCs may move items, that fit in a 2x4 container, from the raid to their stash for a fee that varies based on the value of the items.
